content.json:
## AbuseIPDB Threat Intelligence Workbook
---
This workbook provides visibility into AbuseIPDB blacklist data ingested into Microsoft Sentinel, correlates threat intelligence with your environment's sign-in and network telemetry, and highlights affected users and devices.

**Data source:** `AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL` via the AbuseIPDB CCF Connector

content.query:
AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize
    TotalRecords = count(),
    UniqueIPs = dcount(IpAddress),
    UniqueCountries = dcount(CountryCode),
    AvgScore = round(avg(AbuseConfidenceScore), 1),
    MaxScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore),
    LastIngestion = max(TimeGenerated)
| project
    ['Total Records'] = TotalRecords,
    ['Unique IPs'] = UniqueIPs,
    ['Countries'] = UniqueCountries,
    ['Avg Abuse Score'] = AvgScore,
    ['Max Abuse Score'] = MaxScore,
    ['Last Ingestion'] = LastIngestion
content.title: Ingestion Summary

content.query:
AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Records = count(), UniqueIPs = dcount(IpAddress) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Daily Ingestion Volume

content.query:
AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Count = count() by ScoreBucket = case(
    AbuseConfidenceScore == 100, "100 (Critical)",
    AbuseConfidenceScore >= 90, "90-99 (Very High)",
    AbuseConfidenceScore >= 75, "75-89 (High)",
    AbuseConfidenceScore >= 50, "50-74 (Medium)",
    AbuseConfidenceScore >= 25, "25-49 (Low)",
    "< 25")
| order by ScoreBucket asc
content.title: Abuse Confidence Score Distribution

content.query:
AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= {MinConfidence}
| summarize
    TotalIPs = dcount(IpAddress),
    AvgScore = round(avg(AbuseConfidenceScore), 1),
    CriticalIPs = dcountif(IpAddress, AbuseConfidenceScore == 100),
    HighIPs = dcountif(IpAddress, AbuseConfidenceScore >= 75)
    by CountryCode
| extend CriticalPct = round(100.0 * CriticalIPs / TotalIPs, 1)
| order by TotalIPs desc
| take 25
content.title: Top 25 Countries by Blacklisted IP Count
Blacklisted IPs by Country (Top 15)

content.json:
## 3. Environment Correlation — Sign-ins from Blacklisted IPs
---
Correlates AbuseIPDB blacklisted IPs with Azure AD sign-in logs to identify users authenticating from known abusive IP addresses.

content.query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= {MinConfidence}
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where IPAddress in ((BlacklistedIPs | project IpAddress))
| join kind=inner BlacklistedIPs on $left.IPAddress == $right.IpAddress
| summarize
    TotalSignIns = count(),
    SuccessfulSignIns = countif(ResultType == 0),
    FailedSignIns = countif(ResultType != 0),
    DistinctUsers = dcount(UserPrincipalName),
    AbuseScore = max(AbuseScore)
| project
    ['Total Sign-ins from Blacklisted IPs'] = TotalSignIns,
    ['Successful'] = SuccessfulSignIns,
    ['Failed'] = FailedSignIns,
    ['Distinct Users Affected'] = DistinctUsers,
    ['Max Abuse Score'] = AbuseScore
content.title: Sign-in Correlation Summary

content.query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= {MinConfidence}
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where IPAddress in ((BlacklistedIPs | project IpAddress))
| join kind=inner BlacklistedIPs on $left.IPAddress == $right.IpAddress
| summarize
    TotalAttempts = count(),
    Successful = countif(ResultType == 0),
    Failed = countif(ResultType != 0),
    Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 5),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by IPAddress, AbuseScore, Country
| order by AbuseScore desc, TotalAttempts desc
content.title: Blacklisted IPs Seen in Sign-in Logs

content.query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= {MinConfidence}
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where IPAddress in ((BlacklistedIPs | project IpAddress))
| join kind=inner BlacklistedIPs on $left.IPAddress == $right.IpAddress
| summarize
    SignIns = count(),
    Successful = countif(ResultType == 0),
    Failed = countif(ResultType != 0)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Sign-in Activity from Blacklisted IPs Over Time

content.json:
## 4. Affected Users
---
Users who have authenticated from IP addresses on the AbuseIPDB blacklist.

content.query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= {MinConfidence}
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where IPAddress in ((BlacklistedIPs | project IpAddress))
| join kind=inner BlacklistedIPs on $left.IPAddress == $right.IpAddress
| summarize
    TotalSignIns = count(),
    SuccessfulSignIns = countif(ResultType == 0),
    FailedSignIns = countif(ResultType != 0),
    DistinctBlacklistedIPs = dcount(IPAddress),
    MaxAbuseScore = max(AbuseScore),
    BlacklistedIPs = make_set(IPAddress, 10),
    Countries = make_set(Country, 10),
    Apps = make_set(AppDisplayName, 5),
    FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated)
    by UserPrincipalName
| extend RiskLevel = case(
    SuccessfulSignIns > 0 and MaxAbuseScore >= 80, "Critical",
    SuccessfulSignIns > 0, "High",
    FailedSignIns >= 20, "Medium",
    "Low")
| order by SuccessfulSignIns desc, MaxAbuseScore desc
content.title: Affected Users — Sign-ins from Blacklisted IPs
Top 15 Users with Successful Sign-ins from Blacklisted IPs

content.json:
## 5. Affected Devices
---
Devices communicating with AbuseIPDB blacklisted IPs (Defender for Endpoint telemetry).

content.query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= {MinConfidence}
| summarize AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore), Country = any(CountryCode) by IpAddress;
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp {TimeRange}
| where RemoteIP in ((BlacklistedIPs | project IpAddress))
| join kind=inner BlacklistedIPs on $left.RemoteIP == $right.IpAddress
| summarize
    Connections = count(),
    DistinctRemoteIPs = dcount(RemoteIP),
    DistinctPorts = dcount(RemotePort),
    MaxAbuseScore = max(AbuseScore),
    RemoteIPs = make_set(RemoteIP, 10),
    Ports = make_set(RemotePort, 10),
    Processes = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10),
    FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
    LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
    by DeviceName
| order by Connections desc
content.title: Devices Communicating with Blacklisted IPs
Top Processes Connecting to Blacklisted IPs
Top Destination Ports (Blacklisted IP Connections)

## 6. Threat Intelligence Details
---
Detailed breakdown of the AbuseIPDB blacklist: highest-risk IPs, recently reported IPs, and score trends.

content.query:
AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= {MinConfidence}
| summarize
    AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore),
    Country = any(CountryCode),
    LastReported = max(LastReportedAt),
    TimesSeen = count()
    by IpAddress
| order by AbuseScore desc, TimesSeen desc
| take 50
content.title: Top 50 Highest-Risk Blacklisted IPs

content.query:
AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= {MinConfidence}
| summarize
    AbuseScore = max(AbuseConfidenceScore),
    Country = any(CountryCode)
    by IpAddress, LastReportedAt
| order by LastReportedAt desc
| take 25
content.title: Most Recently Reported Abusive IPs

content.json:
## 7. Geolocation Environment Match
---
Compares countries in the AbuseIPDB blacklist against countries observed in your environment's sign-in logs. Highlights:
- **Overlap countries:** Countries with BOTH legitimate sign-ins AND blacklisted IPs (higher risk)
- **Blacklist-only countries:** Nations with only threat activity (potential geo-blocking candidates)

content.query:
let BlacklistCountries = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= {MinConfidence}
| summarize BlacklistedIPs = dcount(IpAddress), AvgAbuseScore = round(avg(AbuseConfidenceScore), 1) by CountryCode;
let SignInCountries = SigninLogs
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend SignInCountry = tostring(parse_json(LocationDetails).countryOrRegion)
| where isnotempty(SignInCountry)
| summarize SignIns = count(), DistinctUsers = dcount(UserPrincipalName) by SignInCountry;
BlacklistCountries
| join kind=fullouter SignInCountries on $left.CountryCode == $right.SignInCountry
| extend
    Country = coalesce(CountryCode, SignInCountry),
    BlacklistedIPs = coalesce(BlacklistedIPs, 0),
    AvgAbuseScore = coalesce(AvgAbuseScore, 0.0),
    SignIns = coalesce(SignIns, 0),
    DistinctUsers = coalesce(DistinctUsers, 0)
| extend Category = case(
    BlacklistedIPs > 0 and SignIns > 0, "Overlap (Risk)",
    BlacklistedIPs > 0, "Blacklist Only",
    "Environment Only")
| project Country, Category, BlacklistedIPs, AvgAbuseScore, SignIns, DistinctUsers
| order by Category asc, BlacklistedIPs desc
content.title: Geolocation Cross-Reference: Blacklist vs Environment Sign-ins

content.json:
## 8. Security Alerts Correlation
---
Security incidents and alerts involving IP addresses from the AbuseIPDB blacklist.

content.query:
let BlacklistedIPs = AbuseIPDB_Blacklist_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where AbuseConfidenceScore >= {MinConfidence}
| summarize by IpAddress;
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by SystemAlertId
| mv-expand Entity = todynamic(Entities)
| extend EntityIP = tostring(Entity.Address)
| where isnotempty(EntityIP)
| join kind=inner (BlacklistedIPs) on $left.EntityIP == $right.IpAddress
| summarize MatchedIPs = make_set(EntityIP, 10) by SystemAlertId, TimeGenerated, AlertName, AlertSeverity, ProviderName, Status
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    AlertName,
    AlertSeverity,
    ProviderName,
    Status,
    MatchedIPs
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 25
content.title: Security Alerts Involving Blacklisted IPs
